title: fix(scenarios): a replay maps the row a recorded run_action created to its live id
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_
Fixes #35048
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:场景卡回放(`--driver recorded:F`)现在会把录制里 `run_action` 新建出来的记录 id(答案里的 `result.id`)映射到回放应用给的新 id,原来只认 `create_record` 顶层 `id`。
- **为什么改**:travel_expense 的 `file_and_submit_from_text` 由动作建单、再按 id 提交;回放时提交带着旧 id 被拒 RECORD_NOT_FOUND,这道操作题每次回放都读成「未测」,问数技能迭代只能离线评分。
- **风险与回滚**:只动回放驱动里一个私有函数和一个判断,不影响真实运行与评分逻辑;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/driver.ts`(`createdIdOf` 与 `CREATING_TOOLS` 判断);`packages/qa/scenarios/test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`(新增两条回放用例)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts -t "replay re-sends"`,预期 10 条全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`RecordedDriver` re-sends a replayed turn's recorded writes and, for a row the recorded run created, sends later writes with the id the replayed app gave that row. It learned that id only from `create_record` answers (top-level `id`). `run_action` answers what the action body returned under `result` (`{ ok, action, objectName, result: { id } }`), so a row an action created kept its recorded id, and the follow-up write naming it was refused `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` on replay. That made the turn not faithful, and the operation read NOT MEASURED.

- `createdIdOf(tool, output)` reads `result.id` on a `run_action` answer and the top-level `id` on a `create_record` answer, as before.
- The remap runs for an applied answer of either door (`CREATING_TOOLS`), and still only for an applied one.
- No other nested create shape (for example `result.record.id`) is read: nothing in the package knows such a shape.
- `createdIdOf` and `CREATING_TOOLS` are module-private, so no published export changes (`Clause-②: no`). Changeset: patch `@objectstack/scenarios`.

## Tests

Two cases go into the existing driver block of `test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts` (the `runHalf` replay describe), using a stand-in door modelled on the travel_expense build. Filing creates a claim. Submitting it is refused `HOOK_ABORTED`, or `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` for an id the app never gave.

- **Pin:** a recorded `run_action` files a claim (`result.id` = `cl-rec`), the live app gives `cl-live-0`, and the recorded `run_action submit_claim` (same turn) plus a later turn's `update_record` naming `cl-rec` are re-sent naming `cl-live-0`.
- **Control:** a `create_record` row is still remapped from its top-level id into a later `update_record` and a later `run_action`.

Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, fix committed first, test imports `src/` directly so no build sits between): each of the fix's two halves, ablated on its own, turns the pin red with the live failure text. The control stays green. Both restores are proven: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Acceptance notes

- The live replay after the fix grades `file_and_submit_from_text` and fails it only on `status` (`read "draft", declared "submitted"`). The build's own `demotravel_submit_claim` answers `HOOK_ABORTED` (`update('demotravel_expense_claim') does not recognise option 'status'`) in the recording as on replay. That is the authored action's defect, which the score now measures. It is not the replay's.
- The first live "before" attempt was a no-op. It mutated the guard to `c.name === 'create_record'`, which left `CREATING_TOOLS` unused, so the workspace build's DTS step refused (`TS6133`) before anything ran. It was redone with a compile-clean mutation (`CREATING_TOOLS` = `['create_record']`), which is the pre-fix behaviour on this path.
- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exited 3 locally (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: its positive-control commit is not in this shallow clone). That is NOT MEASURED locally and is CI's to read. It is unrelated to this diff.

## Verification

All readings were taken on head `4aa292ec`.

<details><summary>Live replay, before and after (travel_expense, ask, iter2 recording, --packages workspace)</summary>

Command: `run-scenarios --only travel_expense --modes ask --template /mnt/project-files/issue-34687/ask-round-2026-11-17/build/travel_expense/template.json --ask-repeats 5 --packages workspace --driver recorded:/mnt/project-files/issue-34869/skill-iter/iter2/ask.rec.json` (scratch `--work`/`--out`), under the shared verify lock.

| | Run-operations | `file_and_submit_from_text` |
|:---|:---|:---|
| before (`CREATING_TOOLS` ablated to `create_record`; `workspace @ 4aa292ec + uncommitted changes`) | 2/2 · 4 not measured · 2 started from restored rows | NOT MEASURED: `run_action` was refused HOOK_ABORTED in the recorded run and refused RECORD_NOT_FOUND on replay (x2) |
| after (`workspace @ 4aa292ec`) | 2/3 · 3 not measured · 2 started from restored rows | graded, fail: `state:demotravel_expense_claim[trip="t121"].status` read "draft", declared "submitted" (the only failed check) |

The other five operations are the same in both runs: `fix_meal_days` pass, `over_standard_without_reason` pass, and three NOT MEASURED because the seed refused their rows. Run-问数 is 25/25 · 40 not measured in both.

</details>

<details><summary>Unit tests, typecheck, ablation</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck`, then `vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 39 passed (39), Tests 1095 passed (1095). `tsc --listFiles` includes `test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`.
- Block run (`-t "replay re-sends"`): Tests 10 passed | 127 skipped.
- Ablation A: anchor `const holder = tool === 'run_action' ? answer.result : answer;` was replaced with `const holder = answer;` (anchor 1 to 0, blob 8051b98b to 474a9f0f). Result: Tests 1 failed | 9 passed. The pin fails with ReplayNotFaithfulError: "`run_action` was refused HOOK_ABORTED in the recorded run and refused RECORD_NOT_FOUND on replay". Restored to blob 8051b98b == HEAD.
- Ablation B: anchor `if (CREATING_TOOLS.includes(c.name) && recorded === 'applied') {` was replaced with `if (c.name === 'create_record' ...` (blob 8051b98b to b7f4e29d). Result: Tests 1 failed | 9 passed, with the same failure. Restored to blob 8051b98b == HEAD.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/scenarios^...' build`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 64 commands. Each was run with its exit captured before any pipe. 63 exited 0 and `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exited 3 (shallow clone). `dispatch-gates --ran`: "64 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 63 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".
- `overlap-check`: `origin/main` merges cleanly, and no open PR head shares a file. VERDICT clean exit 0.
